question: Which BRICS country has the longest coastline?
solution: The correct answer is __**Russia**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Russia**, a member of the BRICS nations, has the **longest coastline** among the BRICS countries. Its coastline extends to **37,653 km**, making it the **second-longest in the world**, after Canada. • The coastline of Russia stretches along the shores of the **Arctic Ocean, Pacific Ocean, Baltic Sea, Black Sea, and Caspian Sea**, providing it with immense geographical significance. • Russia's coastline covers a wide array of geographical features, including **fjords, gulfs, peninsulas, and islands**, which contribute to its extensive length and ecological diversity. • Among the BRICS nations, the other countries have relatively shorter coastlines: **Brazil** (7,491 km), **China** (14,500 km), **South Africa** (2,798 km), and **India** (7,516.6 km). • The vast coastline of Russia plays a crucial role in its **economic, strategic, and ecological significance**, supporting industries like **fishing, shipping, and oil exploration**.
